sentences.text: Date : 19.10.2023 Heard Mr. M. H. Ahmed, learned counsel appearing for the accused petitioners as well as Mr. B. B. Gogoi, learned Addl. P.P., Assam appearing for Page No.# 2/3 the State Page No.# 1/3 vs The State Of Assam And Anr on 19 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/195469191/

By this petition under Section 439 Cr.P.C., the accused-petitioners, namely,
1. Makbul Hussain, 2. Owaj Kuroni Miya, have prayed for grant of bail in connection with Manikpur P.S. Case No.180/2023 under Section 376 of the IPC, r/w Sections 6/17 of the POCSO Act, r/w Sections 9/10/11 of Prohibition of Child Marriage Act.
It is noticed that the accused petitioners have been in judicial custody since 03.10.2023, i.e. for 16 days.
The matter relates to allegation of child marriage and marital sexual intercourse.

Perusal of the petition and the documents annexed therewith, it is seen that the date of birth of the victim is 01.09.2006 and the FIR was lodged on 03.10.2023 and at the time of lodging of the FIR,
the age of the victim was about 17 years 1 month.
Having heard the learned counsel of both sides and the nature of allegation made in the FIR and also considering the length of detention, this Court is of the considered opinion that further continuation of detention of the accused in the interest of investigation is not warranted.
Accordingly, it is provided that the accused petitioners, named above, shall be released on bail of Rs.
30,000/- each with one surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the learned Special Judge (POCSO Act), Bongaigaon, subject to the following conditions- i) That the accused petitioners shall cooperate with the Page No.# 3/3 Investigating Officer as and when required; and ii) That the accused petitioners shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement,
threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Police Officer or the Court.
This disposes of the bail application.
